summary: This class discusses whether to say the Yud Gimmel Middot before taking out the Sefer Torah on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. It examines the custom of Halab based on the book Dereh Eretz, reports from local Rabbis, and the view of the Mekubalim. It also mentions the custom followed in the teacher's minyan.
questions: Was Yud Gimmel Middot said at Petihat HaEikhal in Halab on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur?
What is the view of the Mekubalim regarding saying Yud Gimmel Middot on Pesach, Shavuot, and Sukkot?
What took place in Brazil in 1961 when a Hazzan started saying Yud Gimmel Middot?
Why does the teacher's minyan not say Yud Gimmel Middot on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur?
